G1_G2.aggregation: Arithmetic mean within each SH0ES calibrator; 42 R22, 25 multi-curve and 17 single-curve

host_published.method: Published diagonal mu_error plus anchor/MAS/HMS shared factors; HMS diagonal is already contained in mu_error

SN_only.method: Public STATONLY aggregated by the G42 arithmetic operator; no cross covariance with compressed HF for matched calibrators

Cepheid_host.method: Public STAT+SYS contains Cepheid-host covariance; cannot be added wholesale without duplication

peculiar_velocity.method: Public VPEC component for sensitivity, not automatic addition; H0DN adds its own velocity variance

BG1.method: Independent BG1 block only under explicit conditional independence, not a measured zero cross-covariance

obstruction.invariance: A is in C support, so (y-Ax)N=yN for every parameter vector x; centering cannot repair support

full_HMS_diagnostic.reason: HMS diagonal is already contained in host mu_error; adding it may double-count variance and is not a physical closure

G42_scenarios.note: Sensitivity only; includes possible Cepheid and intrinsic-scatter duplication and leaves 13 additional calibrators outside the R22 bridge

remaining_open: Source-validated decomposition of host independent and shared HMS variance without duplication
Covariance for the 13 additional non-R22 calibrators from their original sources
Cepheid-host, intrinsic-scatter and PV decomposition before transplanting public matrices
Independent review and route-selection accounting before any observed opening
